scenarios: standalone service diagnostics, fixed cadence, no origin on rejection

nativeDns.initialFailure: instantaneous final FD/task count in one run; root cause unproven
nativeDns.finalCondition: exact same FD/task bounds must converge within 500ms; initial/final observations printed on mismatch

combo35Seconds.scope: earlier diagnostics build before final fixed-vocabulary hardening; periodic event must not count as a reconnect

privacy: no source names, packet bodies, keys or domains
PID and invocation binding; snapshot cache keyed by both
typed counters only; unknown fields cannot enter exported diagnostics
limitations: Process-local sampled counters, not one atomic transaction
Self-reported metadata, not independent pcap evidence
After-ServerHello phase is not end-to-end TLS verification
No claim that diagnostic counters fix WAN or upstream failures
